title: Better to Ask in English: Evaluation of Large Language Models on English, Low-resource and Cross-Lingual Settings
reasoning: The paper evaluates the performance and linguistic bias of LLMs across various languages using Natural Language Inference (NLI) and topic classification datasets. While the methodology section discusses adjusting safety filters to prevent the models from blocking 'harmful content', it does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical topics as a component of the study.
